Descripción del puesto

Phone appointment setter handling and qualifying inbound Facebook leads for high-ticket cash-pay medical treatments in the USA.

Funciones principales

  • Handle inbound leads coming from Facebook campaigns.
  • Qualify inbound prospects over the phone.
  • Schedule appointments for high-ticket cash-pay medical treatments in the USA.

Requisitos

  • Conversational English.
  • Proficiency in CRM tools and lead qualification.
  • Interest in or familiarity with GoHighLevel (GHL) and medical appointment scheduling.

Beneficios

  • Negotiable hourly compensation of $4 to $10 USD.
  • 100% remote freelance work focused on inbound leads.
